units.passage: establish fair and transparent boundaries, and foster student ownership of learning in an AI- enhanced world. The following includes ready-to-use syllabus language, guiding questions, and adaptable frameworks to help you align AI use with your course learning outcomes. 1. ESTABLISH AND COMMUNICATE AI CLASS POLICIES As part of UTEP’s commitment to innovation and academic excellence, we encourage faculty to integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies thoughtfully and transparently into teaching and learning. AI tools can enrich the classroom when used to enhance—not replace—student thinking, creativity, and ownership of learning. Regardless of your approach with AI, you should 1. Communicate your rationale governing your AI stance clearly. Share the “why” with students. 2. Establish fair and transparent boundaries.
units.why: 'Establish fair and transparent boundaries' tells instructors to set clear and fair limits on AI. P124 (apply rules consistently and transparently) is the nearest type.
units.fit_note: Asks for fair and transparent boundaries when they are set, not consistent application across students.
